name: qa.cinematic-short
author: VORTEX-OS
description: Specialist #2 for the cinematic-short template. Calls qa.core for basic checks, then runs director-specific checks: (a) character continuity -- for each character listed in production_bible.json, every scene's hero that should contain that character must match the character's visual description (vision LLM), (b) palette consistency across all heroes, (c) aspect-ratio consistency across all video clips, (d) voice-preset consistency (best-effort: all voiceover files have the same duration-per-scene pattern), (e) transition continuity (each scene's transition_out matches the next scene's transition_in). Returns the standard verdict shape so reviewer.quality can aggregate it. Falls back to 'skip' verdicts for vision checks if mcode-tools is unavailable.

files.description: JSON object mapping scene-NN keys to file paths (e.g. { 'hero_scene_01': '.../imgs/scene-01-hero.png', 'voiceover_scene_01': '.../audio/scene-01-voiceover.wav', 'video_scene_01': '.../video/scene-01-clip.mp4', 'final': '.../acme-final.mp4' })

scenes_manifest.description: Path to the scenes.json produced by scene-decomposer. Used for transition continuity + per-scene aspect checks.

production_bible.description: Path to the production_bible.json. Used for character-continuity checks.

provider.description: mcode-tools (when vision is online) | local-fallback (when offline, vision checks skipped)
